answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by making every identity deposit a stake that is slashed on misconduct: cloning a thousand fake accounts costs a thousand real bonds, so an attacker's budget, not raw signups, becomes the bottleneck. Each new agent enters through a narrow economic inlet, posting a bond whose verifiable pulse on the ledger proves liveness. Honest work compounds that bond into a reputation trail as transparent as crystal, while Sybils forfeit deposits and collapse under their own weight.
